limitations: The regions use the same scan and registered reference assets; V3 is not independent ground truth.
Reference assets are evaluated separately. Output areas are gross and may overlap.
No reference intersection is inconclusive; a zero reference denominator is NA.
Mean distortion loss increases at the same original source cells in all 65 primary-study cases.
The measurements do not establish paper identity, fiber preservation, cross-layer safety, whole-scroll benefit, or text recovery.
All arms use a working-grid interval of 5 voxels; denser output does not add scan information.
The P10 baseline with output spacing 5 voxels resolved the pinned default to float32 from a recorded unset environment.
A failed execution wrapper was retained as failed; its outputs passed a separate artifact and CLI qualification.
